title: Shared IP vs Dedicated IP: Why IPVanish Just Launched a Dedicated IP — and What It Changes for Your Accounts
author: IP Ready Team
excerpt: One IP, one user. On October 30, 2026, IPVanish launched a Dedicated IP add-on: an address reserved exclusively for your account. Until now, IPVanish only offered shared, dynamic IPs — every user on a server pooled behind the same addresses. That gap is exactly what reviewers had flagged for years, and it is why this launch matters beyond one VPN brand: it is a public admission that shared IPs have a reputation problem.
markdown:
**One IP, one user.** On October 30, 2026, IPVanish launched a Dedicated IP add-on: an address reserved exclusively for your account. Until now, IPVanish only offered shared, dynamic IPs — every user on a server pooled behind the same addresses. That gap is exactly what reviewers had flagged for years, and it is why this launch matters beyond one VPN brand: it is a public admission that shared IPs have a reputation problem.

## Why shared IPs get you flagged

When hundreds of strangers share one exit IP, platforms cannot tell you apart. If one of them triggers abuse filters, spam blocks, or a fraud flag, the IP carries that history — and the next user inherits it. That is the same "neighbor risk" behind [CGNAT addresses](/blog/maxmind-shared-ip-confidence-cgnat) and [blacklisted IPs](/blog/why-is-my-ip-blacklisted): **the IP's history follows whoever uses it next, not just whoever caused it.**

## What a dedicated IP fixes — and what it does not

|  | Shared VPN IP | Dedicated IP |
|---|---|---|
| Who else uses it | Hundreds of strangers | Only you |
| Neighbor abuse risk | High — one bad actor taints the pool | Gone — no neighbors |
| VPN/proxy detection | Still detectable as VPN | Still detectable as VPN |
| Login friction (CAPTCHAs, re-verification) | Frequent, unpredictable | Lower and more consistent |
| Anonymity blending | Strong — you hide in the crowd | Weaker — a static IP is a stable identifier |

Two honest caveats. First, a dedicated IP is still a VPN IP, usually from datacenter space — it does **not** make you look [residential](/blog/residential-vs-datacenter-vs-mobile-ip), and platforms that block VPN traffic can still block it. Second, a static IP cuts both ways: if **your own** activity gets that address flagged, there is no pool to disappear into. Dedicated removes other people's risk, not your own.

## Who should care

If you run store, ads, or marketplace accounts, log in to the same platform daily, or keep hitting "unusual traffic" checks on a shared VPN IP, a dedicated IP is worth testing — with one step first: check the address before you commit to it. Run it through a risk check (IP type, blacklist presence, abuse history) the same way you would check any IP you plan to build accounts on. A dedicated IP with a dirty history is just a private version of the same problem.

## Bottom line

Shared IPs fail by association; dedicated IPs fail only by your own record. For account work, that is a real upgrade — as long as you verify the address first and remember it does not hide VPN use.

### FAQ

**Will a dedicated IP stop ChatGPT or Amazon from blocking me?**
It removes shared-pool flags, but platforms that detect VPN traffic may still restrict you — [platform-level IP blocking](/blog/why-chatgpt-claude-blocking-your-ip) works on more than reputation alone.

**Is a dedicated IP more private than a shared IP?**
No — it is more stable and therefore more identifiable. You trade crowd anonymity for consistency.

**Should I switch from a shared VPN IP?**
If repeated verifications or blocks follow you across servers, yes — test one dedicated IP and check its history first.

*Sources: IPVanish, "Take Control of How the Web Sees You: Dedicated IP Is Here" (Oct 30, 2026); TechRadar, "IPVanish finally launches a dedicated IP" (Oct 30, 2026).*

zh.title: 共享 IP vs 专属 IP：IPVanish 为什么这时候推出专属 IP，又会怎样影响你的账号
zh.excerpt: 一个 IP，只属于一个人。2026 年 10 月 30 日，IPVanish 上线了 Dedicated IP（专属 IP）附加服务：一个只分配给你一个账号的地址。在此之前，IPVanish 只有共享动态 IP——同一服务器上的所有用户共用一批出口 IP。这个缺口正是多年来评测一直在指出的短板，而这次上线之所以超出一个品牌本身的意义，在于它公开承认了一个事实：共享 IP 存在声誉问题。
zh.author: IP Ready Team
zh.markdown:
**一个 IP，只属于一个人。** 2026 年 10 月 30 日，IPVanish 上线了 Dedicated IP（专属 IP）附加服务：一个只分配给你一个账号的地址。在此之前，IPVanish 只有共享动态 IP——同一服务器上的所有用户共用一批出口 IP。这个缺口正是多年来评测一直在指出的短板，而这次上线之所以超出一个品牌本身的意义，在于它公开承认了一个事实：**共享 IP 存在声誉问题。**

## 为什么共享 IP 会连累你

几百个陌生人共用一个出口 IP 时，平台无法区分你们。其中一个人触发滥用过滤、垃圾封禁或风控标记，这个 IP 就背上了这段历史——下一个使用者也跟着继承。这和 [CGNAT 地址](/blog/maxmind-shared-ip-confidence-cgnat)、[被拉黑的 IP](/blog/why-is-my-ip-blacklisted) 是同一个逻辑：**IP 的历史跟着下一个使用者走，而不只跟着肇事者。**

## 专属 IP 解决了什么、没解决什么

|  | 共享 VPN IP | 专属 IP |
|---|---|---|
| 还有谁在用 | 几百个陌生人 | 只有你 |
| 被邻居连累的风险 | 高——一个人作恶，整池受牵连 | 没有邻居，也就没有连累 |
| VPN/代理检测 | 仍会被识别为 VPN | 仍会被识别为 VPN |
| 登录摩擦（验证码、反复验证） | 频繁且不可预测 | 更低、更稳定 |
| 匿名混杂 | 强——藏在人群里 | 较弱——固定 IP 就是稳定标识 |

两个必须说清的提醒。第一，专属 IP 仍然是 VPN IP，通常来自机房地址段——它**不会让你看起来像[住宅 IP](/blog/residential-vs-datacenter-vs-mobile-ip)**，屏蔽 VPN 流量的平台照样可以屏蔽它。第二，固定 IP 是双刃剑：如果**你自己**的行为让这个地址被标记，你也没有人群可以躲进去。专属 IP 消除的是别人的风险，不是你自己的。

## 谁最需要关注

如果你运营店铺、广告或电商账号，每天登录同一平台，或者在共享 VPN IP 上反复遇到“异常流量”验证，专属 IP 值得一试——但先做一步：**在长期使用之前先查这个地址**。像检查任何一个准备用来养号的 IP 一样，查它的 IP 类型、黑名单收录与滥用历史。一个本身有前科的专属 IP，只是同一个问题的私人版。

## 结论

共享 IP 的失败来自“连坐”；专属 IP 只会因为你自己的记录而失败。对账号运营来说，这是实实在在的升级——前提是你先验证地址，并且记得它并不能隐藏 VPN 使用。

### 常见问题

**专属 IP 能让我不再被 ChatGPT、亚马逊封吗？**
它消除了共享池的连累，但检测 VPN 流量的平台仍可能限制你——[平台层面的 IP 封禁](/blog/why-chatgpt-claude-blocking-your-ip)看的不只是声誉。

**专属 IP 比共享 IP 更隐私吗？**
不——它更稳定，因而也更容易被识别。你是用人群匿名换来了一致性。

**我该从共享 VPN IP 换过去吗？**
如果你在不同服务器上都反复遇到验证或封禁，可以试一个专属 IP，但先查它的历史。

*来源：IPVanish《Take Control of How the Web Sees You: Dedicated IP Is Here》（2026 年 10 月 30 日）；TechRadar《IPVanish finally launches a dedicated IP》（2026 年 10 月 30 日）。*
